source_status: AI-generated unverified leads; instrument names are not verification

records.reason: The cited rows require the circuit kept live by the project fire strategy. That is not automatically identical to the detector wording about a specified standby supply.
records.followup: Owner review of essential-versus-standby terminology; preserve pre-K4 detector wording until separately evaluated.

source_rows.circumstance: The firefighter lift is not on the power circuit that the fire strategy keeps alive.
source_rows.trigger: connecting a lift to essential power
source_rows.early_warning: The lift feeder is on the general board.
source_rows.derisk: Feed the lift from the supply the strategy names.

source_rows.circumstance: The lift supply is not on the essential circuit the fire strategy requires.
source_rows.early_warning: The feeder is on the general board.
source_rows.derisk: Feed the lift from the essential supply.

records.reason: An explicitly stated device/study mismatch is detected separately in the wording from actual non-coordination. A different device list alone does not establish failed coordination.
records.followup: Owner review of combined flag meaning and severity; no numerical curve assessment by Jev.

source_rows.circumstance: The breakers supplied do not discriminate with the upstream device.
source_rows.derisk: Select devices that discriminate before they are ordered.

source_rows.circumstance: A new breaker does not coordinate with the existing fuses upstream.
source_rows.trigger: adding a breaker downstream of fuses

source_rows.circumstance: A new switchboard manufactured overseas arrives with devices that are not the ones the discrimination study used.
source_rows.early_warning: The device list does not match the study.
source_rows.derisk: Hold the study devices in the order.

records.reason: Supply, rising-main and equipment-load cases share a capacity investigation. B2-0360 explicitly concerns EV chargers; their work system was absent from the predicate and is now included.
records.followup: Kitchen-equipment-only triggering remains a separate coverage question. Confirmed supply capacity alone does not establish adequacy for added demand; no automatic three-phase prescription.

source_rows.circumstance: The consumer mains cannot carry the maximum demand of the new equipment.
source_rows.early_warning: The mains size is below the new demand.
source_rows.derisk: Check the mains before equipment is ordered.

source_rows.circumstance: Vehicle chargers push the existing supply over its limit.
source_rows.early_warning: The demand with the chargers exceeds the supply.
source_rows.derisk: Upgrade the supply or manage the charge load.

source_rows.circumstance: Kitchen equipment load exceeds the diversity the base-building board was sized on.
source_rows.early_warning: The equipment schedule exceeds the allowance.
source_rows.derisk: Size the supply to the equipment.

source_rows.Unforeseen circumstance: Single phase supply cannot support the extension
Tenant fit-out exceeds the electrical rising main capacity
source_rows.Foundational relationship: Mains were sized for typical loads.

records.reason: Crane reach and delivery access share an overhead-conductor constraint. Existing utility supply does not prove overhead lines or lifting work, and absent on-site supply does not prove nearby overhead lines absent.
records.followup: Owner review of applicability precision and current stage attachment; no line-isolation procedure or unverified legal obligation is established.

source_rows.Unforeseen circumstance: Overhead power lines near the crane
source_rows.Foundational relationship: Crane reach and live conductors must stay apart.

source_rows.Unforeseen circumstance: Delivery crane cannot reach due to overhead lines

records.reason: Known inadequate rating and unproved rating are distinct evidence states but both justify checking the project rating. The signal accepts phases OR fault level, so a positive signal cannot close the investigation.
records.followup: Preserve unresolved versus inadequate states in review; refine signals only under a separate measured question change. Contract and severity remain unapproved.

source_rows.circumstance: The board's fault rating is below the fault level the authority now quotes.
source_rows.early_warning: The quoted fault level exceeds the board label.
source_rows.derisk: Confirm fault level before the board is reused or ordered.

source_rows.circumstance: The existing board's fault rating cannot be proved from the label or the records.
source_rows.trigger: adding load to an old board
source_rows.early_warning: There is no rating on the board.
source_rows.derisk: Prove the rating or replace the board.

records.reason: Pole bases, supply pits and crossing excavation share a buried-asset location investigation. Vehicle-access work was absent from this predicate and is now included. Footing work already raises the structure record.
records.followup: Review cross-cluster overlap before adding duplicate footing triggers; the coarse vehicle-access system includes work that may not excavate, so project usefulness remains to be scored.

source_rows.circumstance: A lighting-pole footing clashes with an existing in-ground service.
source_rows.early_warning: The service is in the footing on the utility plan.
source_rows.derisk: Locate services before pole positions are fixed.

source_rows.circumstance: An in-ground supply pit clashes with a new footing.
source_rows.early_warning: The pit is on the footing line.
source_rows.derisk: Locate the pit before footings are set out.

source_rows.circumstance: A street-light cable is cut by a new vehicle crossing.
source_rows.early_warning: The cable is in the crossing on the utility plan.
source_rows.derisk: Locate the cable before the crossing is excavated.

records.reason: A known contaminated capacitor and untested transformer oil are distinct evidence states. The common investigation must not infer contamination from age or a generic survey signal.
records.followup: Review switchboard-only target for lighting-triggered work and material-specific evidence; handling/disposal language and severity remain unverified owner-review items.

source_rows.circumstance: Capacitors in light fittings being removed contain PCBs.
source_rows.early_warning: The capacitor type is a known PCB item.
source_rows.derisk: Dispose of the fittings as the capacitors require.

source_rows.circumstance: An old oil-filled transformer may contain PCBs and blocks the switchroom rebuild.
source_rows.early_warning: The oil has not been tested.
source_rows.derisk: Test and remove the oil before the room is rebuilt.

records.reason: Layout assumptions and occupant-management assumptions both concern whether a project performance solution applies. The broad predicate does not establish that such a solution exists or that its assumptions are breached.
records.followup: Owner usefulness review of broad existing-building triggers and generated design-risk allocation; an approval review is not a statutory conclusion.

source_rows.circumstance: A performance solution for the old use is no longer valid for the new tenancy layout.
source_rows.early_warning: The solution's assumptions are not the new layout.
source_rows.derisk: Revise the solution before the layout is built.

source_rows.circumstance: A fire engineering report assumes a management rule the tenant will not keep.
source_rows.early_warning: The tenant's use breaks the assumption.
source_rows.derisk: Do not rely on a rule the occupant will not keep.

probe.scope: Synthetic new work, existing_building=true, unknown existing systems; only three named UC records inspected, not a full recall score
